# Endorsements
Ryan has earned the support of Florida leaders, legislators, 11 Florida sheriffs, small-business and REALTOR® organizations, and community leaders across Seminole and Volusia counties.
Statewide & Federal Leaders
Ron DeSantis
Governor of Florida
Mike Haridopolos
U.S. Representative, Florida’s 8th District
Anna Paulina Luna
U.S. Representative, Florida’s 13th District
Bill McCollum
Former U.S. Congressman & Florida Attorney General
Law Enforcement · Endorsed by 11 Florida Sheriffs
“Ryan Elijah understands the urgency to fully fund and equip our men and women in law enforcement with the resources needed to keep our families and businesses safe. At a time when extremists on the left are pushing more and more to weaken the rule of law, I am proud to endorse Ryan Elijah for Congress, because I know his commitment to the safety and security of our state will remain a priority.”
Dennis Lemma
